title: Polynomial-time SAT on logarithmic-variable CNFs
claims: LogVariableSAT constructs, for every pair of constants c and d, a language in the exact reference P contained in the exact reference SAT. It accepts every satisfiable encoded CNF with at most c * log2(encoded length + 1) + d distinct variables.
The implementation uses a polynomial-time decoder for one assignment bit per first occurrence of a variable, and a polynomially clocked enumeration of those bit strings.
P_subset_NP is the exact inclusion over the pinned reference and is separately checked.
